summary: Parsing CLI output into native data lets you use when, assert, template, config modules and facts with device state.
questions: Why parse network CLI output in Ansible?
What can I do with parsed device output?

answer_card.title: Why parse CLI text
answer_card.answer_md:
Structured data lets you use native Ansible features:
- `when` to run tasks conditionally
- `assert` to check config/operational compliance
- `template` to build reports
- templates plus `command`/`config` modules to generate device commands
- supplementing platform `facts`
